item.title: Large posters attached to traffic light poles, 23rd November
item.description:
Some of the traffic light poles have large signs for the Blackfen Market attached at head height which means the traffic coming up to the traffic lights is obscured from the pedestrians. As many times cars do not stop at the red lights someone can easily walkout when the pedestrian lights are green as they will not see a car coming. A year or so I reported the same problem with a private company doing the same and they were removed straight away so you would think the Council would know better.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Blackfen Road, Blackfen, Greater London
